Statement: "Join our weekend chess clinic and sharpen your game," says a barangay sports flyer. Which is an assumption implicit in the statement?
optionA: Players can improve their chess through training.
optionB: Everyone in the barangay already plays chess.
optionC: Only clinic graduates win chess tournaments.
optionD: Chess is the most popular game in the barangay.

text: Statement: "Hikers must pass a basic fitness test before climbing Mt. Apo," the park office announced. Which is an assumption implicit in the statement?
optionA: Fit hikers never get injured on the trail.
optionB: The park office wants fewer visitors.
optionC: The climb demands a level of fitness that some hikers may lack.
optionD: Mt. Apo is closed to first-time hikers.

text: Statement: "Train every day if you want to make the provincial track team," the coach told the runners. Which is an assumption implicit in the statement?
optionA: Daily training guarantees a spot on the team.
optionB: Runners who skip a single day will be cut.
optionC: The coach once made the provincial team himself.
optionD: Daily training improves a runner's chances of being selected.
